items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: So finally, I said okay, and I directed the show and she'd play and her husband was the drummer, and the Nicholas Brothers were in the show.

ctx.x: Yeah, and he told me hey, you direct the show and let Mrs. Nicholas play and her husband would play the drums. I said I'm not going to direct no show. This is when I first started, so sure enough I directed this show and let Mrs. Nicholas play the piano and her husband played the
drums and then the Nicholas brothers, oh, they were terrific. And did I tell you about Sammy Davis.
